variants.title: Field along the axis of a solenoid with a Hall-probe gaussmeter
variants.unknown: field along the axis and dB/dx
variants.aim: Move the Hall probe of a gaussmeter along the axis of a solenoid, read the field every few centimetres, and plot the field and its gradient dB/dx.
variants.note: The gaussmeter reads the axial field directly to 0.01 mT; the same solenoid as the search-coil lab.

source.title: University of Delhi B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics practical lists (LOCF 2019 / UGCF 2022)
